headword: {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}

definitions.explanation: A condition where one has little or no desire to eat. Commonly used in medical and health contexts. Composed of {食欲|しょくよく} (appetite) + {不振|ふしん} (poor performance, slump).

examples.japanese: {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: My loss of appetite has been continuing.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}になった。
examples.english: I lost my appetite due to stress.

examples.japanese: {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}や⟦{不眠|ふみん}→不眠：11078_fumin⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you experience symptoms such as loss of appetite or insomnia, please consult a doctor promptly.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal medical or health term. Often listed alongside other symptoms when describing illness or side effects. Can be used as a predicate with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ or ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to lose one's appetite)
- {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (loss of appetite continues)
- {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧ (symptoms of poor appetite)
- {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧ (to report loss of appetite)

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧ (appetite) + ⟦{不振|ふしん}→不振：07771_fushin⟧ (slump, poor performance).
